data.content: BOUNCE FIX at 69ad958d6 (on top of reviewed 6ad1847bf, pushed). Must-fix addressed: writeMessageWakeNotice ack instruction now carries the same addressing as the inbox instruction — agent-addressed notices emit agent_message_ack({messageId, agentId}); session-level notices stay {messageId} (caller-stamp resolution is correct there because the notice lands in that owner session's own wake dir). Regression added: extracts the EXACT notice-suggested ack arguments and executes them against the real ack handler — fails if an agent-targeted notice omits agentId (asserts agentId present AND acked:true round-trip). Gates: mcp-tools regression 495/495 (494+1 new, 27 files), tsc clean, cli build pass, private-guard clean, diff-check clean, files text.
